==Recommended Gem Upgrade Path==
This guide is currently '''under heavy construction''' and will be '''continuously updated and fine-tuned''' in the near future.

It represents the '''combined knowledge of the Discord community''', bringing together established guidelines, visual references, and extensive player feedback. As the game evolves and new optimizations are discovered, this guide will evolve alongside it.

Expect ongoing improvements, refinements, and additions over time. Feel free to @DerSucher for Feedback or criticism.

=== Skill Points ===
There are two main ways to get Skill Points. You can get Skill Bits from Freebie then combine 10 in the Item Bag for 1 Skill Point, this method takes longer but is free. You can also buy 1 Skill Point from the Store for 125 Gems, you can use this method to get Skills faster.

'''Sidenotes: Will get it's own Section together with General tips like "Gild Stonks card ASAP"''' 

* Items Contained in Chests: Increase the /amount of items found in chests over time but save most of the Chests
* Ore Sell Price: Slightly increase ore sell price as you need more Gold
* Fuel Chain Drone and Midas for Gold farming (Chain Drone '''Grade 5''' is required for Challenge 40)

'''Event Note: - Will get it's own Section or Redirect to the Event Guide'''

* If an [[Events|Event]] is live, buy Emporium gifts
* Mythic and Relic chests are acceptable
* See [[Events#Strategy|Event Strategy]] for more information

==== Lootbug 2x Speed ====
Buying 2x Game Speed Buff from [[Lootbugs]] can give you more gems back via [[Freebies]] than you spent on the Bug. This calculator tells you how many gems to expect from buying the Bug.<br>
Note that buying the Lootbug costs 15 Gems by default, reduced by 2 from [[Pets#tabber-Whale_Skin|Whale Pet Skin]], 1 from [[Skill-Tree#Saving For A Rainy Day|Saving for a Rainy Day Skill]], and 1 from owning at least 6 [[Skins|Miner Skins]].

Note that for simplicity the calculator does not take into account gems earned from other sources like additional gem/cherry bombs. For an early game player this is usually between 0.5-1 gems so buying the 2x speed gives you more gems than the amount spent slightly earlier than the calculator claims.
{{Calculator:LootbugSpeed}}

=== ~Obelisk 17 to 29 ===
"Free? That's A Great Price!" and "Stonks" skills are important sources of gem income, relic chest income and Quality of Life upgrades from prerequisites. Consider spending some of the gems from your Obelisk rewards and Freebie Packs on those skills.
